verdict.rationale: Letta's memory system (MemFS, memory blocks, /remember, /init, dreaming) is documented as text/file-based and can ingest arbitrary content via passed memory entries (each becoming a Markdown file) and via connected repos/files, implying non-chat data can enter memory, but there's no explicit documentation of ingesting structured JSON or business data sources (databases, spreadsheets, APIs) into memory as a first-class feature. missing for 10: explicit support/examples for ingesting JSON/structured business data, document upload/parsing pipelines, and any evidence beyond chat-transcript-oriented memory features.
